notes: TNP327C is Altinex's "Tilt 'N Plug" tabletop interconnect/power box for conference tables — a passive pass-through unit, not an active AV switcher/converter, so it doesn't cleanly match the given type taxonomy (classified here as category "other" / type "Other"). Connector cassette is described on the manufacturer page as "HDMI F-M (2), CAT-6 (RJ-45) F-M (2), USB Type A F-M (2)" with 6 ft (2 m) pass-through cables, plus dual AC sockets (120VAC, 60Hz, up to 12A total) fed by a single captive 9 ft (3.0 m) power cord with a standard US NEMA plug — modeled here as one NEMA 5-15 AC input feeding two NEMA 5-15 AC output outlets. No HDMI version, USB speed, or Ethernet speed grade is published on the source page, so grade is correctly omitted for all data ports. Desktop/tabletop unit (5.7 in W x 5.2 in D, 6.4 in H when opened) — rackUnits omitted as not rack-mountable. Content verified identical across three independent fetches of the manufacturer's page (title "TNP327C | Altinex, Inc."); no independent retailer spec table was found to cross-check (Markertek search returned no result), which is the only reason confidence isn't marked higher-assurance via a second source, though the manufacturer page itself is authoritative and internally consistent.
